name: perf_cruise_gpu_auto
what: perf_cruise_gpu WITH THE AUTOMATIC RENDER SCALE (gfx scale 'auto'; the page needs ?autoscale=1 on a rig): switched on at the climb, so the 75 s en route show the scale it settles at ('aascale' events) and the GPU's time with it

steps.name: scale auto
steps.js: (() => { const A = window.FLYDIY_AA, R = window.FLIGHT_REC, H = R && R.header ? R.header() : null; if (window.GFX && GFX.set) GFX.set('scale', 'auto'); return JSON.stringify({ aa: A && A.autoState ? A.autoState() : null, scale: A && A.scale ? A.scale() : null, gpuTimer: H ? H.gpuTimer : null }); })()
